sections.summary: Anders Danielsson is Skanska's President and CEO. Anders Danielsson presented Skanska's Year-end report 2025 at a webcasted press- and audio conference on February 6, 2026, alongside CFO Pontus Winqvist. Anders Danielsson was the new CEO of Stockholm-based contracting giant Skanska AB, speaking in that capacity on a quarterly results call on Feb. 2 (2018). As CEO, Danielsson announced a reduction of Skanska's global workforce by 3,000, of which about 2,500 layoffs were planned in Poland, with about $72 million of $127 million in impairment charges relating to worker-layoff costs. Danielsson told investors he was 'not satisfied' with the prior year's 33% drop in group operating profit and called the 0.8% operating margin in construction activities—2.7% below target—'unacceptable.' Danielsson stated Skanska would focus on its public-private-partnership business in the U.S., where there is 'a tremendous need for infrastructure investment,' while exiting the U.S. power market. Danielsson said Skanska performs well in the Nordics and the majority of the U.S. operation, but has isolated units where profitability needs improvement, and noted a 'very good year' in commercial development with 24 projects started during 2017.
